name: Cultural Landscape of Hawraman/Uramanat
description: High in the Zagros Mountains along Iran's western border, Hawraman is home to the Hawrami, a Kurdish people who have farmed and herded here since about 3000 BCE. Twelve villages cling to steep slopes in tiers, with gardens grown on dry-stone terraces. Families still move between lowlands and highlands with the seasons, as their ancestors did for millennia.
